title: SWF: Gradient fill encoding in DefineShape4
description: Test that a ShapeDisplayObject with a gradient fill (linearGradient or radialGradient) produces a DefineShape4 (tag 83) with gradient fill style type 0x10 (linear) or 0x12 (radial). Verify: (1) FillStyle type byte is 0x10 for linear, 0x12 for radial, (2) gradient stops (color/ratio/alpha) appear in body, (3) gradient matrix encoded as SWF MATRIX record after the GRADIENT record.
